caption_en: Navigation comparisons with explicitly separated input and output conditions. (a,b) Natural-trial position and heading errors for LegSA-GINS and all four dual/single-position IEKF parameter identities. For large body motion, filled triangles use the registered contract start and open triangles retain file-start sensitivity runs. The failed calibrated single-position file-start run is identified in the text area below the panels and has no assigned RMSE coordinate. (c) OiSAM-to-LegSA-GINS RMSE ratios on identical midpoint and nominal-time supports (274 nominal and 54 initial obstruction epochs; no common dynamic output in large body motion). (d) Native position-output availability on the registered one-hertz slots; output availability does not imply accuracy, and GINav outputs remain visible where the speed gate fails. (e) All 18 registered position-interruption cases, including the baseline-retaining IEKF; circles and squares denote 10 and 20 seconds. (f) FGO positioning at GNSS1 on each method's own valid dynamic outputs, with the input layer stated beside each method; these supports and the physical point differ from the common midpoint comparison in (c). Raw-code methods and solution-level methods are not pooled into one ranking.
caption_zh: 导航系统横向比较，分开显示输入与输出条件。（a,b）本文及双/单位置IEKF两种参数的全部自然场景结果；大幅运动的实心三角为登记起点，空心三角保留文件起点敏感性结果。标定单位置IEKF的文件起点失败运行在两面板下方单独说明，不给它赋予RMSE坐标。（c）OiSAM与本文在同一中点、同一名义时刻上的RMSE比值：常规274对，遮挡初段54对，大幅运动无共同动态输出。（d）登记一赫兹时刻的输出可用性；有输出不等同于准确，GINav速度检查失败的输出数量也保留。（e）全部18个位置中断条件，纳入保留基线IEKF；圆/方分别为10/20秒。（f）各FGO路线在GNSS1天线点、各自有效动态输出上的水平RMSE；其物理点和支持范围与(c)共同中点比较不同，标签明确输入层。原始码与解级路线不混成一个总排名。
